source: Derived. api-go is not in the vire tree. Go reverse-proxy of Upgrade lives in CannaMuffinMan/fcgcpa-prod api-go/internal/httpx/server.go (hop-by-hop headers kept when Upgrade is websocket) and proxy_passthrough_test.go (GET /ws/kick with RFC 6455 handshake headers). Frame close codes, 64KiB cap, mask/RSV fail-closed are native RFC 6455 from PR #94 src/rt-ws.vire, not a recorded Go golden.
missing_in_vire: docs/REBUILD-MY-STACK.md is on the rebuild-stack branches, not this native-ws HEAD
api-go WS frame goldens (Go tests only assert Upgrade header reach Node; they do not record 101 accept, echo, or close codes)
not_merged: PR #107 HTTP reverse-proxy primitive was not merged: it strips Upgrade on HTTP and cannot hijack RFC 6455. This lane terminates WS on the listen socket like native ELF.
